raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fix stable CUDA Docker dependency resolution so the CUDA-specific PyTorch index is authoritative for PyTorch packages.

The Dockerfile previously passed the CUDA index as an extra index while the environment used `unsafe-best-match`. In a `cu129` build, that allowed dependency resolution to select a higher preinstalled Torch build from another source, producing the reported `torch 2.14.0+cu130` / `torchvision 0.28.0+cu129` mismatch and breaking `import torchvision`.

Stable CUDA install stages now use the CUDA index as the primary index, PyPI as the fallback for non-PyTorch packages, and `unsafe-first-match` so package resolution cannot silently substitute a different CUDA build. The change is applied consistently to base, build, test/dev, runtime, vLLM wheel, and extension install stages.

## Validation

- `git diff --check` passes.
- Resolved the CUDA requirements with uv's stable-index configuration for a Linux manylinux target; local execution of the full image is unavailable because the Docker daemon is not running.

Fixes #59157

files.patch:
@@ -253,8 +253,13 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/opt/uv/cache \
         && uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python3 -r requirements/cuda.txt \
         --extra-index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/nightly/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.'); \
     else \
+        # Keep the CUDA-specific PyTorch index first. Using it as an extra
+        # index with unsafe-best-match can select a higher, incompatible
+        # torch build from the base image (for example cu130 in a cu129 image).
         uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python3 -r requirements/cuda.txt \
-        --extra-index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.'); \
+        --index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.') \
+        --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
+        --index-strategy unsafe-first-match; \
     fi
 
 # Track PyTorch lib versions used during build and match in downstream instances.
@@ -372,7 +377,9 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/opt/uv/cache \
     else \
         echo "Installing build requirements..." \
         && uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python3 -r requirements/build/cuda.txt \
-        --extra-index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.'); \
+        --index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.') \
+        --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
+        --index-strategy unsafe-first-match; \
     fi
 
 WORKDIR /workspace
@@ -732,7 +739,9 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/opt/uv/cache \
     else \
         echo "Installing dev requirements..." \
         && uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python3 -r requirements/dev.txt \
-        --extra-index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.'); \
+        --index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.') \
+        --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
+        --index-strategy unsafe-first-match; \
     fi
 
 #################### DEV IMAGE ####################
@@ -941,7 +950,9 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/opt/uv/cache \
     else \
         uv pip install --system \
             -r /tmp/requirements-cuda.txt \
-            --extra-index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.'); \
+            --index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.') \
+            --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
+            --index-strategy unsafe-first-match; \
     fi && \
     rm /tmp/requirements-cuda.txt /tmp/common.txt
 
@@ -1017,7 +1028,9 @@ RUN --mount=type=bind,from=build,src=/workspace/dist,target=/vllm-workspace/dist
     else \
         echo "Installing vLLM..." \
         && uv pip install --system dist/*.whl --verbose \
-        --extra-index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.'); \
+        --index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.') \
+        --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
+        --index-strategy unsafe-first-match; \
     fi
 
 # Expose the Rust frontend bundled in the wheel on the container's PATH.
@@ -1140,7 +1153,9 @@ RUN --mount=type=bind,from=build,src=/workspace/dist,target=/vllm-workspace/dist
     else \
         echo "Installing vLLM..." \
         && uv pip install --system dist/*.whl --verbose \
-        --extra-index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.'); \
+        --index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.') \
+        --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
+        --index-strategy unsafe-first-match; \
     fi
 
 # Pytorch now installs NVSHMEM, setting LD_LIBRARY_PATH
@@ -1150,7 +1165,9 @@ COPY --from=build /tmp/ep_kernels_workspace/dist/wheels.sha256 /tmp/ep-kernels-w
 RUN --mount=type=bind,from=build,src=/tmp/ep_kernels_workspace/dist,target=/vllm-workspace/ep_kernels/dist \
     --mount=type=cache,target=/opt/uv/cache \
     uv pip install --system ep_kernels/dist/*.whl --verbose \
-        --extra-index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.')
+        --index-url ${PYTORCH_CUDA_INDEX_BASE_URL}/cu$(echo $CUDA_VERSION | cut -d. -f1,2 | tr -d '.') \
+        --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
+        --index-strategy unsafe-first-match
 
 # See the matching comment in the vllm-base stage.
 ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/nvidia/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}
